text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The winner of this year's Spring Grand Prix is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The winner's name was called out.
However, that name was not
<chrname>'s.
choice_data_list: (I really wanted to win this one, though...!)

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Spectator
text_block_list.text:
We're not giving up!!
On your victory! On seeing you become number one in the world!

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Article
text_block_list.text:
"We simply looked up to her.
I think we just accepted that she was far away,
someone entirely beyond our reach."

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Article
text_block_list.text: ""When she strikes the turf in frustration, we hold back our own tears of regret just the same.""

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Article
text_block_list.text: "Seeing her vow to turn even this defeat into strength warms the heart, earning her a round of applause."

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Article
text_block_list.text:
""We already share the same aspirations as her.
Instead of looking up at it from below as mere 'admiration'—""

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Article
text_block_list.text: Seeing the dream of becoming the world's best as an achievable goal.

text_block_list.name: Monthly Twinkle Article
text_block_list.text:
"—'If it's her,
　I believe she can make it happen.'
　　　　Interview & Article: Etsuko Otonashi"

text_block_list.name: Campus Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone in Project L'Arc!
Assemble in the gymnasium immediately!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days had passed since the Takarazuka Kinen...
An announcement from Chairwoman Akikawa echoed throughout the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And alongside <chrname>,
I head for our destination. This time, to the venue of
the National Representative Match to decide Japan's representative.
